text: Search Search Menu Physical and Financial Conditions at Selected Mitchell-Lama Developments (2024-N-4) Overview This dashboard provides additional photographs related to the audit of the New York City Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) Physical and Financial Conditions at Selected Mitchell-Lama Developments. Auditors examined operations at three developments: Clinton Towers in Manhattan, Evergreen Gardens in the Bronx, and Tivoli Towers in Brooklyn, and found unsafe and unsanitary conditions at all three developments. The photographs were taken by auditors during site visits to the developments. Photographs can be filtered by various categories such as: by development, by location, and by condition. Notes for each photo are included to provide a brief description of the condition. Please view the full audit report for all audit findings related to the audit of the three Mitchell-Lama developments.
